args.message: I can't answer this as asked. Today is 2026-10-06, so the last three complete calendar months are July, August and September 2026. The orders data stops at 2025-12-31, so there are no orders at all for those months. That's a gap in the data, not real zero revenue. The latest three complete months that do have data are Oct 2025: 9,750.92 (133 orders), Nov 2025: 7,270.00 (118 orders) and Dec 2025: 11,287.69 (170 orders). These totals include orders of every status, both 'ok' and 'bad'.
